title: Linearly Solvable Continuous-Time General-Sum Stochastic Differential Games
abstract: arXiv:2604.07479v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper introduces a class of continuous-time, finite-player stochastic general-sum differential games that admit solutions through an exact linear PDE system. We formulate a distribution planning game utilizing the cross-log-likelihood ratio to naturally model multi-agent spatial conflicts, such as congestion avoidance. By applying a generalized multivariate Cole-Hopf transformation, we decouple the associated non-linear Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equations into a system of linear partial differential equations. This reduction enables the efficient, grid-free computation of feedback Nash equilibrium strategies via the Feynman-Kac path integral method, effectively overcoming the curse of dimensionality.

translated_title: 可线性求解的连续时间一般和随机微分博弈
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一类连续时间、有限参与者的随机一般和微分博弈，这类博弈可通过精确的线性偏微分方程（PDE）系统求得解。我们构建了一个分布规划博弈，利用交叉对数似然比来自然地建模多智能体之间的空间冲突，例如拥堵规避问题。通过应用广义多元Cole-Hopf变换，我们将相关的非线性Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）方程解耦为一组线性偏微分方程。这一简化使得能够借助Feynman-Kac路径积分方法高效地、无需网格地计算反馈纳什均衡策略，从而有效克服了维数灾难。
tldr: 本文提出一类可通过广义多元Cole-Hopf变换将非线性HJB方程解耦为线性PDE系统的连续时间一般和随机微分博弈，从而借助Feynman-Kac路径积分方法实现反馈纳什均衡的无网格高效求解并克服维数灾难。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a class of continuous-time general-sum stochastic differential games whose nonlinear HJB equations can be decoupled into a linear PDE system via a generalized multivariate Cole-Hopf transformation, enabling efficient grid-free computation of feedback Nash equilibria through the Feynman-Kac path integral method and effectively overcoming the curse of dimensionality.
